draft.subject: Ledgerlane's seed round and your first sales hires
draft.body:
Hi Meera,

I read that Ledgerlane raised ₹6 Cr in its seed round and plans to use it to build its first enterprise sales team. Selling AI reconciliation to mid-sized manufacturers is a long sale, and the pilots with two auto-component makers in Pune look like a good base for it.

Your Accelerator runs a 12-week programme for pre-seed and seed B2B and AI founders in India. The part most relevant to you is go-to-market support: introductions to first enterprise customers and help hiring the first sales roles.

If useful, you can apply at https://example.com/apply or book a 20-minute call at https://example.com/20-min-call.

Rohit
Programme Lead, Your Accelerator
